sources: IBPS CRP PO/MT notification and call letter pages on ibps.in, recent cycles

admitCard.where: The CRP PO/MT section on ibps.in
admitCard.when: Call letter is released about one to two weeks before the exam (for the 2026 prelims it was released on 14 August for exams on 22 and 23 August)
steps: Open ibps.in, go to the CRP PO/MT section and choose the call letter link for the stage.
Sign in with your registration or roll number and your date of birth or password.
Download the call letter and print it. IBPS does not post a hard copy.
Check the date, shift, reporting time and venue, and keep an ID proof ready.
carry: The original photo ID named in the call letter
A passport size photograph and other items only if the call letter asks for them
admitCard.note: Keep the call letter and ID proof together in one folder from the day it is released.

answerKey.summary: IBPS has not released answer keys or question papers for the PO prelims or mains in recent cycles, and there is no objection window. Your first official feedback is the result and the scorecard.
answerKey.note: Coaching institutes publish unofficial keys right after each shift. Treat their scores as an estimate, because weighted marking and sectional cutoffs also apply.

result.summary: IBPS declares each stage on ibps.in. You sign in and see your result, and the scorecard follows within days, available for a limited time.

stages.what: Qualifying only. Shortlists candidates for mains who clear the sectional and overall cutoffs. Prelims marks do not count in the final merit.
Score out of 225 across the objective tests and the descriptive paper, with a minimum in each test. Shortlists candidates for the interview.
Final score is 80 percent mains plus 20 percent interview, followed by allotment to participating banks.

result.scorecard: The scorecard gives section-wise marks and the overall total. Download it and save the PDF while the link is active, because IBPS keeps it online only for a limited period.
